choices.title: Crown Moulding
choices.description: Crown molding is a visual treat that adds a touch of elegance. Crown moldings made of wood come in hundreds of profiles and can be stained, painted, or left natural. Here you will find some visualizations: www.thisoldhouse.com/ideas/39-crown-molding-design-ideas

choices.title: Tray Ceiling
